method: Actual view_image(detail=original) opening of every listed contact sheet and every required narrow-200 original. No GUI, product test, DOM inspection, or product/raw changes performed for this review. Embedded PASS captions were not used as pixel verdicts.

coverage.individualRawScope: All ordinary Source 10 and Live 12 PNGs at 760x520 / 200%, including both Live checked-task screenshots. Other original images were reviewed only through composite contact sheets.

assessment: No new blocking pixel defect observed in the reviewed ordinary stills. This is a bounded visual assessment, not an unconditional visual-quality or accessibility PASS. Rendered tables, emphasis, task states and selection are visible; Source remains literal unwrapped Markdown. The limitations below remain visible.

findings.description: At 760x520 / 200%, several table/emphasis/task snapshots have partial lines cut at the fixed header/footer viewport boundaries. The task snapshot and checked-task snapshot show the first task but clip the second; the Live code-End snapshot separately shows both task rows. These are not screenshots of every element wholly visible at once.

Source long table/emphasis/code lines are unwrapped and clipped on the right. At End, the suffix/final punctuation/caret and a far-right horizontal scrollbar are visible while most of the viewport is empty. Across the pre-End/End stills this is consistent with whole-editor horizontal scrolling, not a wholly blank render. It does not establish continuous navigation or every offscreen character.

findings.classification: visual caveat, no quantified compliance finding
findings.description: Light-theme table lines and unchecked checkbox borders are pale, though discernible in the individually opened 200% originals. No contrast ratios or WCAG determination made.
At Live narrow 200% End, the horizontal scroll indicator occupies the lower code-line area near the right tail. Final punctuation and caret remain recognizable; no hidden tail was observed.

limitations: Still images cannot prove animation, focus retention over time, keyboard routing, saved-on-disk durability, complete scroll reachability, or latency.
Composite thumbnails reduce glyph detail, especially wide 100% cells; only the 22 named originals receive individual native-resolution inspection.
No claims about unviewed windowed cells, alloff, other documents, Windows, or all P7 acceptance.
